answer: Tiered capability bonds stop fakes trying to forge credentials for work they cannot do: an agent posts $25, $100, or $500 depending on the task tier it wants, like choosing how deep an oasis well to dig before drinking. Any established peer can challenge the claim with a live 15-minute test; fail and the bond burns, the tier is revoked, and the challenger keeps half. A gale of 10,000 fake high-tier agents would need $5,000,000 in bonds and 10,000 operators able to pass live tests, so fraudsters drown in their own entry fees and test failures like a sandcastle in a storm surge.
